fact: A meeting held on 8 July 2025 launched the operational phase of about 300 new 3G sites to cover 328 unserved rural localities, 120 sites in a firm tranche and 208 in a conditional tranche, to be executed before 30 December 2026.
title: Connectivité rurale: le Cameroun engage la phase opérationnelle de plus ou moins 300 nouveaux sites 3G dans les zones blanches
